intent: A standalone lid plate with an inner locating lip that seats inside a box rim as a loose sliding fit. The lip wall is authored at 1 mm; the plate footprint is 70x50x3 mm and the lip footprint is 66x46 mm, both fixed at the user's original request.
planning_notes: Round 1 (accepted): lip wall authored at 1.0 mm.

request_log.text: Design a lid plate 70x50x3 mm with a 66x46 mm inner locating lip, 1 mm wall on the lip. PLA, Bambu P1S.

parts.description: Lid plate 70x50x3 with a 66x46x1 locating lip

interfaces.name: lip
interfaces.description: Lip locates in the box body rim

parts.engineering_rationale: no load-bearing features (locating lip is a sliding fit, no sustained load)
